description: An engraved metal plate cut with a coat of arms or device, struck under heat and pressure to stamp the whole image at once. Because the gold lies in a single plane it reads as a flat solid figure rather than the catch-light texture of hand tooling.
name: arms block

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XV, p.227. Internet Archive.
